description: A web page for visualizing database contents, including database list, tables, and table data with interactive features and styling.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for selected table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with rows and columns.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
